summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Vodafone Group PLC disclosing a TR-1 notification of major holdings. BNP Paribas SA crossed a 5% threshold, now holding 5.84% voting rights via shares and 0.64% via financial instruments (call options, total return swaps, swaps) for a combined 6.49%. There is no acquisition/divestiture or corporate action by the issuer; it is a routine passive stake disclosure. This does not represent a special situation.
